selection_rule.description: Combine two interventions at different model layers because each reduced forward KLD when measured alone. Freeze the pair before measuring its combined model effect. Cross-layer effects may be non-additive, so the component measurements do not predict the combined result.
selection_rule.component_measurement_reference: the same published 2,048-token BF16 reference was used for both component-specific absolute-target screens

components.construction: K3 gate, up, and down reconstruction with a BF16 rank-four activation-weighted correction added to the reconstructed down projection
K3 gate and up reconstruction with a reconstructed-activation down target encoded at K3

evidence_boundary: The registration freezes a two-layer composition before its combined measurement. The combined 2,048-token result is an exploratory interaction screen because that reference already informed both component choices. Independent document-level references must confirm any reduction. The dense endpoints are experiment representations. The layer-3 correction charges 65,536 logical BF16 factor bytes, while a complete GLM QSRT checkpoint byte ledger remains unimplemented.
